guide.wayfarers.airship_compass.p0: Right-click to find the nearest Sky Harbour (in the End: the Void Ship Wreck). Its aether needle then keeps pointing there.
guide.wayfarers.airship_compass.p1: Craft: a compass, an aether crystal and three brass ingots.
guide.wayfarers.airship_compass.title: Airship Compass
guide.wayfarers.armor.p0: Wear all four pieces of a set to get its bonus: Explorer (speed, soft landings, night vision underground), Ember (fire immunity) and Void (slow fall, saved from the void).
guide.wayfarers.armor.p1: Craft them like iron armour: Explorer from leather and Map Fragments, Ember from Ancient Embers, Void from Void Shards.
guide.wayfarers.armor.title: Armour sets
guide.wayfarers.backpack.p0: Travel Backpack: hold it and right-click to open 27 extra slots that travel with you. Craft: a chest, a string and seven leather.
guide.wayfarers.backpack.p1: Explorer's Backpack: 54 slots. Craft your Travel Backpack with a brass ingot: nothing inside is lost.
guide.wayfarers.backpack.title: Backpacks
guide.wayfarers.biomes.p0: New worlds of the Default type get three biomes of their own, carved out of vanilla climates on Minecraft's usual terrain: the Crimson Mire, the Volcanic Highlands and the Pale Dunes. Each has its colours, its ground and its natural objects.
guide.wayfarers.biomes.p1: To find one: /locate biome wayfarers:crimson_mire (or volcanic_highlands, pale_dunes). Villages, temples and Wayfarers structures of the climate they replace appear there too.
guide.wayfarers.biomes.p2: Superflat, Amplified and Large Biomes worlds, and worlds created before, keep vanilla's biomes. A server can turn them off for new worlds (option world.customBiomes).
guide.wayfarers.biomes.title: Wayfarers biomes
guide.wayfarers.blood_moon.p0: Every few nights a Blood Moon rises: monsters are much stronger and elites much more common. Stay together, light your base and wait for dawn.
guide.wayfarers.blood_moon.title: Blood Moon
guide.wayfarers.bosses.p0: The big structures hide a boss arena behind a wall of mist; the journal gives each boss its quest. Walk through the mist to wake the boss: the mist seals until the fight ends.
guide.wayfarers.bosses.p1: Watch the wind-ups: every attack is announced by an animation or a circle on the ground. Hit it after a big attack, and break its poise to stagger it.
guide.wayfarers.bosses.p2: If everyone leaves the arena, the boss heals and goes back to sleep.
guide.wayfarers.bosses.title: Bosses
guide.wayfarers.brass_golem.p0: A clockwork companion: it follows you and fights monsters with a 12-damage piston punch, and slams the ground when they crowd it. 80 health, 10 armour.
guide.wayfarers.brass_golem.p1: To build it: stack two Blocks of Brass one on the other, then right-click them with a Clockwork Heart. It wakes up and follows whoever built it.
guide.wayfarers.brass_golem.p2: Clockwork Heart: a brass gear, two brass ingots, a block of redstone and a clock. Brass gears: a brass ingot surrounded by four brass nuggets (makes 2). Block of Brass: nine ingots.
guide.wayfarers.brass_golem.title: Brass Golem
guide.wayfarers.brass_golem_orders.p0: Sneak-right-click it with an empty hand: "guard here" (it stays and defends the spot) or "follow me". If it falls 28 blocks behind, it catches up by itself.
guide.wayfarers.brass_golem_orders.p1: It attacks every monster within 16 blocks except creepers, and never hurts players, villagers or pets.
guide.wayfarers.brass_golem_orders.p2: Repair: right-click it with a brass ingot (+20 health) or a brass nugget (+3). Destroyed, it drops its heart and some brass, so you can rebuild it.
guide.wayfarers.brass_golem_orders.title: Golem orders
guide.wayfarers.chisel.p0: It carves a placed block into another variant of its family. Craft, in a column: an iron ingot, a brass ingot, a stick.
guide.wayfarers.chisel.p1: Right-click a block: next variant (stone, bricks, mossy, cracked, chiseled...). Sneak-right-click: the previous one. Each cut uses one durability.
guide.wayfarers.chisel.p2: Stairs, slabs and walls keep their shape; copper keeps its age and wax. Works on stone, deepslate, tuff, sandstone, quartz, prismarine, blackstone, terracotta, copper and the Wayfarers blocks.
guide.wayfarers.chisel.p3: Some steampunk variants only exist through the chisel: brass tiles, engraved brass, brass grille, copper tiles, dark iron bricks, mahogany parquet...
guide.wayfarers.chisel.title: Engraver's Chisel
guide.wayfarers.chisel_table.p0: It carves a whole stack at once. Craft: two brass ingots, a chisel and five planks.
guide.wayfarers.chisel_table.p1: Right-click the table and put a stack of blocks in its slot: every variant of the family appears on the right. Click one to turn the whole stack into it.
guide.wayfarers.chisel_table.p2: It is free and the table never wears out.
guide.wayfarers.chisel_table.title: Chisel Table
guide.wayfarers.clockwork_citadel.p0: A walled steampunk town around a clock tower over 70 blocks tall, with workshops and smoking chimneys.
guide.wayfarers.clockwork_citadel.p1: Where: badlands, savannas, deserts and plains.
guide.wayfarers.clockwork_citadel.p2: Its clockmakers still work in the halls, guarded by Brass Golems; a Tinkerer gives contracts in the first workshop. A stair in the tower's entrance hall leads down to the Gearworks, where Clockwork Spiders swarm, and the Clock Vault, lair of the Grand Clockmaker (see Automatons).
guide.wayfarers.clockwork_citadel.title: Clockwork Citadel
guide.wayfarers.clockwork_spider.p0: Hostile clockwork spiders that roam in packs at night in the badlands and the savanna highlands, and in the Clockwork Citadel and the Undercity. They climb walls.
guide.wayfarers.clockwork_spider.p1: When one stops and its key whirs, it is about to leap: step aside. They drop brass nuggets, redstone and sometimes a brass gear.
guide.wayfarers.clockwork_spider.title: Clockwork Spider
guide.wayfarers.company.p0: A Company is your party: up to 8 players. Invite someone from their card (sneak + right-click them) or from the Company screen (O); with no company yet, inviting founds one. They accept from the chat or their own Company screen.
guide.wayfarers.company.p1: Companions appear at the left of the screen with their health and the way to them, and gold-framed on the minimap and world map.
guide.wayfarers.company.p2: The leader sets two switches: friendly fire (off by default: companions cannot hurt each other, arrows and potions included) and shared experience (orbs you pick up are split with the companions within 48 blocks).
guide.wayfarers.company.p3: Company chat: /cc your message, or the Company chat switch that sends all your chat to the company.
guide.wayfarers.company.title: The Company
guide.wayfarers.company_travel.p0: Standing at a waystone, select a companion in the Company screen and click Join. They get a request; once they accept, you pay 2 experience levels and appear beside them.
guide.wayfarers.company_travel.p1: It refuses when they fly, fall, swim in lava, fight a duel or stand near a boss, and it can only be used every 2 minutes.
guide.wayfarers.company_travel.title: Joining a companion
guide.wayfarers.compass.p0: It finds Wayfarers structures. You get one when you first arrive; craft more with a compass surrounded by four Map Fragments.
guide.wayfarers.compass.p1: Right-click: the chat shows the nearest one (name, distance, direction and coordinates) and sparks show the way.
guide.wayfarers.compass.p2: Sneak-right-click: choose which structure to look for, one kind at a time, or "any structure". The wonders come at the end of the list.
guide.wayfarers.compass.title: Structure Compass
guide.wayfarers.contract_board.p0: Post tab of a Contract Board: click the sample slot with the item you want (a copy, it stays yours), set how many, put the reward in the reward slots and post. The reward is held by the contract until someone delivers.
guide.wayfarers.contract_board.p1: Anyone with the goods in their bag clicks Deliver: the goods go to your Pneumatic Post inbox and the reward to them, at the same moment. Tools must be undamaged.
guide.wayfarers.contract_board.p2: Cancel your own contract to get the reward back. Unfulfilled contracts expire after 7 days and the reward comes back by post. Craft: three paper, two brass nuggets, planks and two sticks.
guide.wayfarers.contract_board.title: Guild contracts
guide.wayfarers.contracts.p0: People with a name tag hand out contracts: Guild Agents (villages, Guild Outposts), Scholars (village inns, the Forgotten Library), Tinkerers (village workshops, the Clockwork Citadel), Druids (the Hollow Giant Tree) and Dwarf Elders (the Deep Dwarven City).
guide.wayfarers.contracts.p1: Right-click one to talk. "!" marks a new contract, "?" one you can hand in. Pick it, read what they ask, then Accept. Track pins it to the top-right of your screen.
guide.wayfarers.contracts.title: Quest givers & contracts
guide.wayfarers.contracts_kinds.p0: Four kinds: bring items (they are taken when you hand them in), hunt creatures (kills after accepting count), find a structure (just walk into it), and deliver a sealed parcel to another quest giver.
guide.wayfarers.contracts_kinds.p1: Come back to the giver and press Turn in (Hand over for a parcel) for emeralds, experience and gear. Lost a parcel? Its giver hands you another. Each player has their own contracts; finishing one unlocks the next. The journal (J) lists them in its Contracts tab.
guide.wayfarers.contracts_kinds.p2: Quest givers stay at their post, cannot be hurt and never leave. Villagers and quest givers live in the Guild Outposts, the monastery, the library, the lighthouse, the World Tree, the oasis, the observatories, the rune circle and the ziggurat's keepers' lodge, and in most wonders: no monster spawns inside those.
guide.wayfarers.contracts_kinds.title: Contracts: kinds & rewards
guide.wayfarers.crate.p0: A crate holds 32 stacks of a single item and shows it on its front with the count. Right-click with an item to put it in; right-click twice quickly to put in every one you carry.
guide.wayfarers.crate.p1: Left-click takes a stack (sneak: a single item). Hoppers, the Guild Terminal and quick-stack treat crates like chests that accept only their item.
guide.wayfarers.crate.p2: Craft: a barrel, four iron ingots and four planks.
guide.wayfarers.crate.title: Compacting Crate
guide.wayfarers.crimson_mire.p0: A blood-red marsh under a rosy haze: crimson nylium, mud and podzol, dark red water and drifting spores. Curved horns of blackstone rise from the mud, and giant red mushrooms with weeping vines shade the pools. Witches, slimes and the Bogged live here like in any swamp.
guide.wayfarers.crimson_mire.p1: Where: the wettest swamps (about two swamps in five).
guide.wayfarers.crimson_mire.title: Crimson Mire
guide.wayfarers.crystal_cathedral.p0: A gothic cathedral of calcite, quartz and amethyst inside a giant geode, with a rose window, spires and crystal pillars.
guide.wayfarers.crystal_cathedral.p1: Where: under any biome, deep down (floor around y -30).
guide.wayfarers.crystal_cathedral.p2: In the north transept, a stair goes down to the crypt, where the reliquary waits behind iron bars.
guide.wayfarers.crystal_cathedral.title: Crystal Cathedral
guide.wayfarers.danger.p0: Monsters get stronger the further you travel from spawn, below sea level, in the Nether and in the End. The current level shows above your hotbar when it changes.
guide.wayfarers.danger.p1: Elites have a gold name and a gold frame on their health bar. They hit hard but drop materials, emeralds and sometimes a Recall Scroll.
guide.wayfarers.danger.title: Danger levels
guide.wayfarers.diving_gear.p0: Diving Helmet: a brass dome with a porthole. With your head under water it gives Conduit Power: you breathe, see clearly and mine at full speed. Craft it from four Sea Serpent Scales, a brass ingot and glass, or from two brass ingots, three copper blocks and glass.
guide.wayfarers.diving_gear.p1: Flippers: swim much faster. Two leather and two dried kelp blocks.
guide.wayfarers.diving_gear.title: Diving gear
guide.wayfarers.duels.p0: Challenge a player from their card. If they accept, a red ring marks the arena around you and a 3-2-1 countdown runs: no hit counts before "Fight!".
guide.wayfarers.duels.p1: Nobody dies: the blow that would kill leaves half a heart and ends the duel. Leaving the ring or logging out forfeits; after 3 minutes it is a draw. Outsiders cannot hit duelists and duelists cannot hit them.
guide.wayfarers.duels.p2: Wins and losses are kept on the player card, and the server hears who won.
guide.wayfarers.duels.title: Duels
guide.wayfarers.dwarven_city.p0: A lost dwarf kingdom carved in the rock: a great cavern with a lava hearth, forges, a tavern, terraces of houses and a mine-cart line. A waystone waits by the hearth.
guide.wayfarers.dwarven_city.p1: Where: under any biome, at the bottom of the world (floor around y -48).
guide.wayfarers.dwarven_city.p2: Behind the great gate and its two 22-block dwarf statues: the Great Hall, the Throne Room and, under a carpet behind the throne, a trapdoor to the treasure vault, still guarded by skeleton knights. Dwarves live in the forges and houses; the Dwarf Elder gives contracts by the tavern hearth.
guide.wayfarers.dwarven_city.title: Deep Dwarven City
guide.wayfarers.emotes.p0: Press Y for the emote wheel: wave, bow, cheer, clap, point, laugh, thank and rally. Click one or press its number; everyone within 24 blocks sees your arms move, the sparks and the words above their hotbar.
guide.wayfarers.emotes.p1: Point draws a line of light where you look; Rally blows a steam whistle to gather the company.
guide.wayfarers.emotes.title: Emotes
guide.wayfarers.geothermal_foundry.p0: Steampunk ironworks built into a smoking volcano: a lava caldera under a bridge crane, casting halls and four 55-block chimneys.
guide.wayfarers.geothermal_foundry.p1: Where: badlands, savanna plateaus and windswept savannas.
guide.wayfarers.geothermal_foundry.p2: Inside the mountain lies the Forge of the Deep: steam hammers, blast furnaces and, at the back, the Heart around a lava well. Fire resistance helps.
guide.wayfarers.geothermal_foundry.title: Geothermal Foundry
guide.wayfarers.glider.p0: Hold it in either hand and jump from somewhere high: it opens by itself. You sink slowly and glide where you look, and landing never hurts.
guide.wayfarers.glider.p1: With the Grappling Hook: climb a tower, then glide to the next one. It wears in flight; repair it with brass.
guide.wayfarers.glider.p2: Craft: three brass ingots, four leather and a phantom membrane.
guide.wayfarers.glider.title: Brass Glider
guide.wayfarers.grand_clockmaker.p0: The boss of the Clockwork Citadel (400 health). A stair in the tower's entrance hall goes down through the gearworks to a waiting room with a waystone, before the mist of the Clock Vault.
guide.wayfarers.grand_clockmaker.p1: He sweeps his pendulum cane, slams it (jump the ring of sparks), throws cogs and winds up spiders. When his hands rewind and a ring closes around him, get out of it or be frozen in time.
guide.wayfarers.grand_clockmaker.title: The Grand Clockmaker
guide.wayfarers.grand_clockmaker_midnigh: At half health he gets faster: he skips through time to reappear behind you, then tolls midnight: twelve bells burst around him, then a thirteenth under your feet. Move as soon as you see a glint.
His Remembrance, four Map Fragments and two diamonds forge the Clockmaker's Pendulum, which slows foes.
guide.wayfarers.grapple.p0: Right-click to fire the claw up to 32 blocks. When it bites a block, the chain reels you in; a small hop at the end lifts you onto the ledge.
guide.wayfarers.grapple.p1: Sneak or right-click again to let go. No fall damage while reeled in, nor just after.
guide.wayfarers.grapple.p2: Craft, in a column: a tripwire hook, an iron chain, a brass ingot.
guide.wayfarers.grapple.title: Grappling Hook
guide.wayfarers.grave.p0: When you die, your belongings are kept in a grave where you fell. Its coordinates are sent in the chat.
guide.wayfarers.grave.p1: Right-click the grave to get everything back. A friend can also open it: the items then go into their inventory.
guide.wayfarers.grave.title: Graves
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.p0: One screen for every chest of your base. The terminal links every chest, barrel, shulker box, sorting chest and compacting crate up to 48 blocks around it (32 up and down). No cables, no power.
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.p1: Craft: a chest, two gold ingots, a Map Fragment, redstone and four planks. Bigger base? Add Storage Relays instead of more terminals.
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.p2: Take: click an item for a stack (right-click: half, middle-click: one, shift: straight into your inventory). Store: click the grid with an item, or shift-click it in your inventory. Store all and Store matching empty your inventory in one click.
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.p3: Sneak-right-click the terminal to sort every linked chest at once. Chests in unloaded chunks, unopened loot chests, hoppers and machines are never linked.
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.title: Guild Terminal
guide.wayfarers.harvest.p0: Right-click a ripe crop (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, nether wart, cocoa...) to harvest it and replant it in one go.
guide.wayfarers.harvest.title: Right-click harvest
guide.wayfarers.inventor_manor.p0: A Victorian steampunk mansion: turrets, a copper roof, an observatory with a telescope, a glass conservatory and a workshop wing.
guide.wayfarers.inventor_manor.p1: Where: plains, meadows, flower forests and cherry groves.
guide.wayfarers.inventor_manor.p2: Secret: in the study, a carpet hides a trapdoor down to the inventor's laboratory, which keeps the best loot.
guide.wayfarers.inventor_manor.title: Inventor's Manor
guide.wayfarers.keys.p0:
J: quest journal
K: talent tree
V: use your active talent
R: sort your inventory
M: world map
H: show/hide the minimap
Shift + H: minimap size
Z: minimap zoom
B: ping the spot you look at
N: magnet ring on/off
G: Builder's Wand symmetry
W (held over an item): its manual page
guide.wayfarers.keys.p1: These are the keys of a QWERTY keyboard: Options > Controls, Wayfarers section, shows yours and changes them. Display settings (health bars, damage numbers, tracker, tips, and the minimap's size, corner, shape, rotation, coordinates and opacity): Config button of Wayfarers in the mods list. The minimap's exact size (a slider) and the maps' relief: M, then the gear button.
guide.wayfarers.keys.title: Keys
guide.wayfarers.machine_screens.p0: Top of the screen: the machine and a status line with a lamp. Green: working. Amber: waiting (no ripe crops, no redstone signal...). Red: stuck (output full, nothing to place). Hover anything for a tip.
guide.wayfarers.machine_screens.p1: Area machines (Harvester, Sprinkler, Vacuum, Detector): pick the size, and the box button draws the work area in the world until you switch it off.
guide.wayfarers.machine_screens.p2: Redstone mode (Harvester, Sprinkler, Vacuum, Timer): always on, only with a signal (lit torch) or only without one (unlit torch). The little lamp next to it shows the signal the machine receives.
guide.wayfarers.machine_screens.p3: Harvester: replanting and output side (a green dot marks the sides with a container). Vacuum: 5 filter items (only these, or all but these) and a button to take the stored experience. Shift-click fills or empties their slots.
guide.wayfarers.machine_screens.title: Machine screens
guide.wayfarers.machines.p0: No cables, no power: each machine is one block that does one job. Click a machine to open its screen: what it does, what it is doing right now, and its settings. The Brass Wrench turns it; sneak + wrench changes its main setting without opening the screen.
guide.wayfarers.machines.p1: A simple farm: Sprinkler in the middle of the field, Auto-Harvester at the edge with a chest against it. Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, nether wart, cocoa, melons, pumpkins, sugar cane, cactus and bamboo all work.
guide.wayfarers.machines.p2: Vacuum Hopper above a chest: it collects everything dropped around it, even experience.
guide.wayfarers.machines.p3: Craft: most machines use brass ingots and redstone around the tool of their job (hoe, pickaxe, dispenser, hopper...); the Sprinkler is four copper ingots around a water bucket.
guide.wayfarers.machines.title: Farm machines
guide.wayfarers.magic.p0: Each staff holds one spell: hold it and right-click to cast. Spells cost mana, shown in the blue bar above your experience; it refills by itself.
guide.wayfarers.magic.p1: Spells: fire bolt, frost nova, Tesla lightning, mending, levitation, ward and steam blast. Each staff is crafted upright: an amethyst shard between two of its element (blaze powder, packed ice, copper...) on top, a collar, a stick.
guide.wayfarers.magic.p2: More mana: an Arcane Ring (+50 mana) or a Mana Amulet (faster regeneration) work just by being in your inventory. Arcanist talents and robes make spells stronger.
guide.wayfarers.magic.title: Magic
guide.wayfarers.magnet.p0: While it is in your inventory and switched on (it glows), items and experience within 7 blocks fly to you.
guide.wayfarers.magnet.p1: Right-click it or press N to switch it on or off.
guide.wayfarers.magnet.p2: Craft: two Map Fragments, a redstone and three iron ingots.
guide.wayfarers.magnet.title: Magnet Ring
guide.wayfarers.map.p0: The minimap in the corner shows the land around you, where you face, and the nearby waystones, waypoints, players, pings, graves and your last death. H hides it, Shift + H: size, Z: zoom.
guide.wayfarers.map.p1: M (or the Wayfarer's Atlas, sneaking) opens the world map. Drag to move it, wheel to zoom, Space to come back to you. Click a marker for its card.
guide.wayfarers.map.p2: On a server the map is shared: what anyone explores appears on everyone's map. Underground, the map shows the cave around you instead of the surface.
guide.wayfarers.map.p3: Right-click the map: add a waypoint (name, colour, icon, private or shared). Its card lets you edit, share or delete it.
guide.wayfarers.map.p4: Middle-click the map, or press B while looking at a spot, to ping it: everyone sees it for a minute.
guide.wayfarers.map.p5: The cube button tilts the world map into a 3D view. The gear button: minimap size (48 to 160 px, shown live), corner, shape, opacity, relief and contour lines.
guide.wayfarers.map.title: Map and minimap
guide.wayfarers.materials.p0: Map Fragments come from Overworld ruins, Lithite from deep ores, Ancient Embers from the Nether and Void Shards from the End. They repair and craft the gear of each region.
guide.wayfarers.materials.title: Materials
guide.wayfarers.metal_armor.p0: Brass set: night vision and faster mining. Mithril set: +4 health and +10% speed. Aether set: +75 mana, mana refills twice as fast, no fall damage.
guide.wayfarers.metal_armor.p1: Arcanist robes are woven from Arcane Cloth (purple wool, string and an aether crystal): +100 mana and spells 25% stronger.
guide.wayfarers.metal_armor.p2: Craft each piece like iron armour, from brass or mithril ingots, aether crystals or Arcane Cloth.
guide.wayfarers.metal_armor.title: Advanced armour
guide.wayfarers.multiplayer.p0: On a server, the Guild is more than a word: form a Company with your friends, trade face to face, send letters and parcels by Pneumatic Post, post contracts for the goods you need, greet people with emotes and settle disputes in a duel.
guide.wayfarers.multiplayer.p1: Keys: O company, Y emote wheel, U card of the player you look at (or sneak + right-click them with an empty hand). Change them in Options > Controls, Wayfarers: multiplayer.
guide.wayfarers.multiplayer.p2: Everything is checked by the server, and an admin can switch off each feature in wayfarers-common.toml (section social).
guide.wayfarers.multiplayer.title: Playing together
guide.wayfarers.ocean_creatures.p0: Glow Jellyfish drift in every sea, in four colours. Bumping into one stings (a little poison). They drop Glow Jelly: brew it into an Awkward Potion for Night Vision, or put four around glass for a Jelly Lamp.
guide.wayfarers.ocean_creatures.p1: Reef Fish swim in schools in warm seas: sunburst, clown or azure. Catch one with a water bucket.
guide.wayfarers.ocean_creatures.p2: Manta Rays glide near the surface and sometimes leap out of the water. Humpback Whales live in the deep: they rise to blow and sing from far away. Both are peaceful.
guide.wayfarers.ocean_creatures.title: Sea creatures
guide.wayfarers.oceans.p0: The seas are full of life now: schools of reef fish, glowing jellyfish, manta rays, and far out in the deep, humpback whales. Dive and look around: the floor hides kelp forests, coral gardens, glowing anemones, pearl oysters, bubble vents, rock arches and sunken ruins.
guide.wayfarers.oceans.p1: Small wrecks wait on the sea floor too: a sunken steampunk submarine, a diving bell with air inside, coral shrines in warm seas and fields of shipwreck debris. Each has loot.
guide.wayfarers.oceans.title: Living oceans
guide.wayfarers.ores.p0: Zinc is common in stone (y -16 to 96). Craft 3 copper ingots + 1 zinc ingot into 4 brass ingots: brass tools are faster than iron and enchant well.
guide.wayfarers.ores.p1: Mithril hides deep in deepslate (below y -8, iron pickaxe). Aether crystals glow faintly between y -48 and 32. Orichalcum is found in the Nether. Smelt raw ores like iron.
guide.wayfarers.ores.title: Ores & brass
guide.wayfarers.pale_dunes.p0: A white desert of pale sand rippled with gold, smooth sandstone underneath. Banded terracotta hoodoos stand like chimneys between the dunes, some with a sandstone cap. Husks, camels and desert villages are at home here too.
guide.wayfarers.pale_dunes.p1: Where: the driest deserts (about one desert in four).
guide.wayfarers.pale_dunes.title: Pale Dunes
guide.wayfarers.pneumatic_post.p0: Every Pneumatic Post opens your own inbox: letters and parcels from other players, contract deliveries and items given back. Select one to read it; Take items puts in your bag what fits and leaves the rest.
guide.wayfarers.pneumatic_post.p1: Write tab: type the name of any player who ever joined (Tab completes it), a letter, and up to 6 stacks in the parcel slots. Postage: 1 brass nugget, plus 1 per stack. The parcel arrives at once, even if they are offline.
guide.wayfarers.pneumatic_post.p2: Craft: brass ingots around glass, two copper ingots and a chest.
guide.wayfarers.pneumatic_post.title: Pneumatic Post
guide.wayfarers.quests.p0: Open the journal with J or by using the Wayfarer's Atlas. Five chapters lead you from the first Guild Outpost to the End; each quest shows its objective, your progress and its rewards.
guide.wayfarers.quests.p1: Click Track to pin a quest to the top-right of your screen. When it is done, the tracker moves on to the next quest by itself.
guide.wayfarers.quests.p2: Progress is shared: when a friend completes a step, it counts for the whole group, even offline players. Every quest also gives talent points.
guide.wayfarers.quests.title: Quests & journal
guide.wayfarers.recall.p0: Use it to return instantly to the nearest waystone of your dimension. It is used up.
guide.wayfarers.recall.p1: Elites sometimes drop one. Craft 2 with paper, a Map Fragment and an ender pearl.
guide.wayfarers.recall.title: Recall Scroll
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.p0: Redstone Timer: a ready-made clock. Its screen has a slider for the interval (0.5 s to 1 minute), the pulse length, a redstone mode to pause it, and a bar counting down to the next pulse.
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.p1: Tree farm in 3 blocks: Timer -> Block Breaker facing the trunk -> Block Placer with saplings below it. Their screens show the block they will break or place next, and where the items go.
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.p2: Wireless Transmitter and Receiver: pick the same colour among the 16 swatches of their screens (or use a dye on them) and the signal travels without wires; the screen counts the transmitters and receivers on that channel.
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.p3: Entity Detector: pick what it looks for (players, monsters, animals, items or all creatures) and how far; it outputs 1 per creature (max 15), or the opposite when inverted: on while nothing is near.
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.title: Easy redstone
guide.wayfarers.refill.p0: When the stack in your hand runs out (last block placed, last food eaten, tool broken), the next stack of the same item from your inventory takes its place by itself.
guide.wayfarers.refill.title: Hotbar refill
guide.wayfarers.remembrance.p0: Every boss drops its Remembrance. Craft it with four materials of its region (Map Fragments, Lithite, Ancient Embers or Void Shards) and two diamonds to forge its unique weapon, with a special right-click power.
guide.wayfarers.remembrance.title: Boss weapons
guide.wayfarers.rivet_gun.p0: Right-click to fire a hot rivet: 5 damage, fast and nearly straight. Ammo: Rivets from your inventory, or iron nuggets.
guide.wayfarers.rivet_gun.p1: Craft: three brass ingots, a copper ingot, a piston and a plank. 12 Rivets: an iron ingot, a copper ingot and a zinc nugget.
guide.wayfarers.rivet_gun.title: Rivet Gun
guide.wayfarers.sea_floor.p0: Pearl Oysters lie in beds in temperate and warm seas. Right-click an open shell to take its pearl; it grows a new one in time. Four pearls trade for an emerald at the crafting table.
guide.wayfarers.sea_floor.p1: Bubble vents rise from basalt chimneys: swim into the column to shoot up to the surface and breathe. Glow Anemones light the floor at night; pick them up to decorate an aquarium.
guide.wayfarers.sea_floor.title: The sea floor
guide.wayfarers.sea_serpent.p0: At night, over deep water, a boat or a swimmer may draw the Sea Serpent: a long crested beast with a boss bar. It bites, lunges from afar (boats in its way break) and roars up a whirlpool that drags you in and tips riders into the sea.
guide.wayfarers.sea_serpent.p1: Fight it from a solid spot or under water with a Diving Helmet. It drops Sea Serpent Scales, prismarine and sometimes a Heart of the Sea. Unfought, it sinks away at dawn.
guide.wayfarers.sea_serpent.title: Sea Serpent
guide.wayfarers.sky_harbour.p0: A steam airship moored at the top of a 44-block iron tower, seen from far away.
guide.wayfarers.sky_harbour.p1: Where: plains, meadows, savannas and hills. The Airship Compass points to the nearest one.
guide.wayfarers.sky_harbour.p2: Climb the tower to the docking arm to board the ship: deck, cabin, propeller and engines. Bring the Grappling Hook and the Brass Glider.
guide.wayfarers.sky_harbour.title: Sky Harbour
guide.wayfarers.sky_isles.p0: An archipelago of floating islands linked by rope bridges: waterfalls, a giant cherry tree, a ruined watchtower, aether crystals and a ruined shrine with the treasure altar.
guide.wayfarers.sky_isles.p1: Where: high above oceans, plains and meadows (from about y 170 to y 230).
guide.wayfarers.sky_isles.p2: To get up: pillar up with blocks, use the Grappling Hook or a levitation wand. The Brass Glider brings you back down safely. Beware the gargoyle in the tower.
guide.wayfarers.sky_isles.title: Sky Isles
guide.wayfarers.sorting.p0: Press R to sort your main inventory (not the hotbar or armour): stacks are merged and grouped.
guide.wayfarers.sorting.title: Inventory sorting
guide.wayfarers.sorting_chest.p0: A big 54-slot chest that sorts itself when nobody is looking inside, and vacuums items dropped within 6 blocks.
guide.wayfarers.sorting_chest.p1: Sneak-right-click to sort it right now. Put one next to your mob farm or your mine entrance.
guide.wayfarers.sorting_chest.p2: Craft: a chest, a hopper and seven planks.
guide.wayfarers.sorting_chest.title: Sorting Chest
guide.wayfarers.steam_blocks.p0: Brass, copper and dark iron plating, clockwork and gauge panels, pipe bundles, Edison lamps, aether conduits, mahogany panelling, tufted leather and smokestack bricks. Most plates also come as stairs and slabs.
guide.wayfarers.steam_blocks.p1: Tip: keep brass for the trims and let dark iron and mahogany carry the mass; light it with Edison lamps. The Engraver's Chisel unlocks more variants.
guide.wayfarers.steam_blocks.title: Steampunk blocks
guide.wayfarers.steam_drone.p0: Hostile flying drones: at night over the steampunk lands, and in the Undercity. They circle and fire hot rivets.
guide.wayfarers.steam_drone.p1: When one rears up, it is about to dive at you: step aside. A bow brings them down. They drop brass nuggets, copper and sometimes a brass gear.
guide.wayfarers.steam_drone.title: Steam Drone
guide.wayfarers.storage_buttons.p0: Every chest, barrel or backpack shows small brass buttons above it: Sort, Take everything, Deposit the items it already holds, and Quick-stack into the chests around you.
guide.wayfarers.storage_buttons.p1: Type in the search box to light up the matching slots. Middle-click any slot to sort its inventory.
guide.wayfarers.storage_buttons.title: Storage buttons
guide.wayfarers.storage_relay.p0: A small brass beacon that stretches a Guild Terminal's reach: every chest up to 32 blocks around the relay joins the terminal's network. One terminal can then reach the whole base, even several buildings.
guide.wayfarers.storage_relay.p1: Craft (makes two): an ender pearl, four brass ingots, a redstone and a copper ingot.
guide.wayfarers.storage_relay.p2: Place it within 48 blocks of the terminal, or within 32 blocks of another linked relay: relays chain, so you can reach a far storage hall step by step. Right-click a relay to check that it is linked.
guide.wayfarers.storage_relay.title: Storage Relay
guide.wayfarers.sylvan_palace.p0: An elven palace grown around a colossal silver tree 70 blocks tall. A spiral stair climbs around the trunk to three terraces and their pavilions.
guide.wayfarers.sylvan_palace.p1: Where: dark forests, old-growth taigas, old-growth birch forests and flower forests.
guide.wayfarers.sylvan_palace.p2: Inside the trunk: the throne hall and the royal treasury. Up in the leaves: the library and, at the very top, the Moon Lantern. Rope bridges lead to three tree houses. The sylvan court lives in the pavilions: a healer, librarians, a weaver, a cook, a gardener and the royal cartographer.
guide.wayfarers.sylvan_palace.title: Sylvan Palace
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.p0: Build in mirror: every block the wand places is copied on the other side of a plane.
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.p1: 1. Sneak-right-click a block with the wand: it becomes the mirror centre (sparks show the plane) and mirror X turns on.
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.p2: 2. Press G (or sneak-click the centre again) to switch: off, mirror X (east/west), mirror Z (north/south), mirror X + Z (4 ways).
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.p3: 3. Build as usual: gold outlines are your blocks, blue ones their mirrored copies (stairs turn the right way). Each copy costs a block; undo removes them all.
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.title: Wand symmetry
guide.wayfarers.talents.p0: Press K to open your talent tree: four branches, Warrior, Explorer, Arcanist and Engineer. Each talent costs points and needs one of the talents linked above it.
guide.wayfarers.talents.p1: Points: 1 per quest (3 for a boss quest) and 1 every 10 experience levels gained.
guide.wayfarers.talents.p2: The last talent of each branch is an active power: once unlocked, click it to equip it, then press V to use it.
guide.wayfarers.talents.p3: Changed your mind? Drink a Vial of Oblivion to get every point back (glass bottle, ghast tear and amethyst shard).
guide.wayfarers.talents.title: Talent tree
guide.wayfarers.terminal_network.p0: Items go first into a chest that already holds the same item, then into sorting chests, then into any free slot. Search by name (@name: by mod); the sort button cycles count, name and mod.
guide.wayfarers.terminal_network.p1: The chest-network button (top right) lists the linked containers by type. Click one to exclude it, like a trash chest or a furnace input chest; click again to link it back. "Show in world" outlines them all for 10 seconds: gold linked, red excluded.
guide.wayfarers.terminal_network.title: Terminal: network & sorting
guide.wayfarers.terrain_touches.p0: The vanilla biomes get a few natural touches: mossy boulders in plains, meadows, forests and taigas, fallen logs in dark forests, savannas and cherry groves, wildflower patches, moss carpets under old trees, small rock spires on stony peaks and windswept hills, and hot-spring terraces in the savanna highlands.
guide.wayfarers.terrain_touches.p1: Each can be switched off on a server (options world.terrain.*); new chunks only.
guide.wayfarers.terrain_touches.title: Wilder landscapes
guide.wayfarers.tesla_observatory.p0: A science campus on a rocky crag: a copper dome with a 30-block telescope, a 70-block Tesla tower and an orrery under a glass dome.
guide.wayfarers.tesla_observatory.p1: Where: on mountain tops and windswept hills.
guide.wayfarers.tesla_observatory.p2: Between the buildings: the library, the laboratory and the star-chart hall. Bring blocks to climb the crag.
guide.wayfarers.tesla_observatory.title: Tesla Observatory
guide.wayfarers.tools.p0: The Excavator Pickaxe mines 3x3 and the Lumber Axe fells whole trees. Sneak to break a single block.
guide.wayfarers.tools.p1: Craft each with three Lithite shards and two sticks, shaped like a pickaxe or an axe.
guide.wayfarers.tools.title: Special tools
guide.wayfarers.trade.p0: Open a player's card (sneak + right-click them) and click Trade. When they accept, a trade screen opens for both: put what you give in your 9 slots, watch their offer on the right.
guide.wayfarers.trade.p1: When both press Accept, a 3-second countdown starts. Any change to either offer cancels both acceptances, so nobody can swap an item at the last moment. At zero the items change hands at once.
guide.wayfarers.trade.p2: Stay within 8 blocks. Walking away, closing the screen or logging out gives each offer back to its owner; what no longer fits goes to your Pneumatic Post inbox, never on the ground.
guide.wayfarers.trade.title: Secure trade
guide.wayfarers.undercity.p0: A town on stilts clinging to the walls of a vast cavern, around a central pillar and a toxic green lake, joined by catwalks and lit by lamps.
guide.wayfarers.undercity.p1: Where: under any biome, deep down: its lake lies around y -15.
guide.wayfarers.undercity.p2: A family lives in every stilt house and no monster spawns in the cavern. Climb the pillar's ladders to reach the upper levels and the vault.
guide.wayfarers.undercity.title: The Undercity
guide.wayfarers.villages.p0: Every kind of village (plains, desert, savanna, snow, taiga) grows new buildings in its own style: an inn with rooms, a tinkerer's workshop, a watchtower, a market, an orchard, cottages, manors and wells.
guide.wayfarers.villages.p1: About one village in four is built around a square with a waystone: right-click it to put the village on the travel map. The notice board and the meeting bell stand beside it.
guide.wayfarers.villages.p2: Quest givers live there too: a Guild Agent in the Guild Post and by the square's notice board, a Scholar in the inn's tavern, a Tinkerer in the workshop. Right-click them for contracts.
guide.wayfarers.villages.p3: Streets get brass lamps, signposts and planters. Pillager outposts now field steam ballistas and spiked barricades.
guide.wayfarers.villages.title: Villages
guide.wayfarers.volcanic_highlands.p0: Ochre mountains banded with terracotta under an ashen sky. Black rock and glowing magma break through the tan grass, lava pools steam in the hollows and lava trickles down the slopes. Smoke rises from vents, and a few Rustwoods cling to the ground. Watch your step.
guide.wayfarers.volcanic_highlands.p1: Where: half of the mountain ranges of the badlands.
guide.wayfarers.volcanic_highlands.title: Volcanic Highlands
guide.wayfarers.wand.p0: It lays whole rows of blocks at once. Hold it and look at a block: gold outlines show where the copies will go. Right-click to extend that face with blocks of the same kind from your inventory (16 at a time, 64 with the Master wand).
guide.wayfarers.wand.p1: Made a mistake? Sneak-right-click in the air to undo the last use: the blocks come back to you.
guide.wayfarers.wand.p2: Craft, in a column: an amethyst shard, a gold ingot, a stick. Master wand: the wand between two Lithite shards, a diamond above it.
guide.wayfarers.wand.title: Builder's Wand
guide.wayfarers.watch.p0: Its hand follows the sun, and a little window shows the sun by day and the moon by night.
guide.wayfarers.watch.p1: Right-click: time, day number, moon phase and the biome you stand in.
guide.wayfarers.watch.p2: Craft: a brass nugget, three brass ingots and a redstone.
guide.wayfarers.watch.title: Pocket Watch
guide.wayfarers.waystones.p0: Waystones link the world. Right-click one to discover it for the whole group and open the travel map.
guide.wayfarers.waystones.p1: In the map, click a destination then Travel (or double-click it). Pin your favourites with the star and rename them.
guide.wayfarers.waystones.p2: Craft your own for your base, your farms or a dungeon entrance: an ender pearl, two Map Fragments, a compass and three stone bricks.
guide.wayfarers.waystones.title: Waystones
guide.wayfarers.welcome.p0: This world hides dozens of hand-built structures, dungeons, bosses and giant wonders. Your group explores it together: quests, waystones and discoveries are shared by everyone.
guide.wayfarers.welcome.p1: To begin, press J (or use the Wayfarer's Atlas) and follow the first chapter of quests.
guide.wayfarers.welcome.p2: This manual explains every system. Click a page in the contents on the left; turn pages with the arrows, the mouse wheel or the arrow keys. When a page goes on, the button reads "More >".
guide.wayfarers.welcome.p3: Shortcut: hover a Wayfarers item in your inventory and hold the manual key (W, or the key its tooltip shows; Controls to change it) to open its page. Lost the manual? Craft a book and a feather.
guide.wayfarers.welcome.title: Welcome, Wayfarer
guide.wayfarers.wonders.p0: Wonders are giant places, far bigger than other structures: towns, palaces, a volcano, caverns, islands in the sky... Each one has its page in this chapter, and finding it completes a quest.
guide.wayfarers.wonders.p1: The ten wonders: Clockwork Citadel, Sky Harbour, The Undercity, Deep Dwarven City, Sylvan Palace, Inventor's Manor, Sky Isles, Geothermal Foundry, Tesla Observatory and Crystal Cathedral.
guide.wayfarers.wonders.p2: They are rare, often one or two thousand blocks apart. Sneak-right-click the Structure Compass until it names the one you want (wonders are at the end of the list), then right-click it for the distance and direction.
guide.wayfarers.wonders.p3: Underground wonders lie under any biome: dig down to the depth given on their page.
guide.wayfarers.wonders.title: How to find them
guide.wayfarers.world_stones.p0: Three stones, found in big veins like granite: marble in the mountains (from y 32 up), rust rock in the badlands and the savanna highlands, blue slate deep down in the deepslate (below y 0).
guide.wayfarers.world_stones.p1: Polished, bricks, pillar, tiles, stairs, slabs and walls come from the stonecutter, and the Engraver's Chisel switches between them.
guide.wayfarers.world_stones.p2: Or craft them: two calcite and two diorite make 4 marble; four granite around an iron nugget, 4 rust rock; four cobbled deepslate around a lapis lazuli, 4 blue slate.
guide.wayfarers.world_stones.title: Marble, rust rock, blue slate
guide.wayfarers.world_woods.p0: Two woods to grow yourself. Glowwood: pale trunks under teal leaves that glow at night. Rustwood: dark red bark and rust-orange leaves on forked trees.
guide.wayfarers.world_woods.p1: Craft a sapling: an oak sapling, glow berries and glowstone dust (Glowwood); an acacia sapling and raw iron (Rustwood). Elven and forest ruins hide Glowwood saplings in their chests, steampunk workshops Rustwood ones.
guide.wayfarers.world_woods.p2: Each gives a full set like oak: logs, bark, planks, stairs, slabs, fences, gates, doors, trapdoors, buttons and pressure plates. An axe strips the logs; the leaves drop saplings that grow the same tree.
guide.wayfarers.world_woods.title: Glowwood and Rustwood
guide.wayfarers.wrench.p0: Right-click a block to turn it: stairs, logs, chests, hoppers, signs, machines, furniture. Sneak: the other way. Doors, beds and double chests stay put.
guide.wayfarers.wrench.p1: Sneak-right-click: a Wayfarers machine changes its setting; Wayfarers decoration or furniture comes back to your inventory.
guide.wayfarers.wrench.p2: Craft: three brass ingots and an iron ingot.
guide.wayfarers.wrench.title: Brass Wrench

npc.wayfarers.greet.druid: The World Tree listens to those who care for the forest. What will you do for it?
npc.wayfarers.greet.dwarf_elder: Hmph. Surface folk. Prove your worth and the deep halls will remember your name.
npc.wayfarers.greet.guild_agent: The Guild always needs a hand. Here is what is pinned on my board today.
npc.wayfarers.greet.scholar: Ah, a traveller! Knowledge hides in dangerous places. Will you help me fetch some?
npc.wayfarers.greet.tinkerer: Mind the gears! I always need parts, and someone brave enough to test my contraptions.
npc.wayfarers.idle.druid: The forest is at peace. Walk softly, friend.
npc.wayfarers.idle.dwarf_elder: You have done the clans proud. The forges sing your name.
npc.wayfarers.idle.guild_agent: No more contracts for you today, wayfarer. The roads are safer thanks to you.
npc.wayfarers.idle.scholar: My notes are complete, for now. Come back when the world has new secrets.
npc.wayfarers.idle.tinkerer: Every gear is in its place. Tick, tock, perfect.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_gift.descriptio: Bring the Druid's seed pouch to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_gift.story: The Guild feeds many mouths. Take them these seeds from the World Tree; they grow anywhere.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_gift.title: A Gift for the Guild
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_palace.descript: Find the Sylvan Palace, then come back to a Druid.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_palace.story: Our sisters of the Sylvan Palace sing under a pale tree. Find them and bring me news of their court.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_palace.title: The Sylvan Court
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_saplings.descri: Bring 8 Oak Saplings to a Druid.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_saplings.story: Every tree cut must be given back. Eight oak saplings, and the forest forgives.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_saplings.title: Seeds of the Forest
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_spiders.descrip: Defeat 10 Spiders, then come back to a Druid.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_spiders.story: Spiders weave over our nests and smother the young leaves. Drive them out of the canopy.
npcquest.wayfarers.druid_spiders.title: Webs in the Branches
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_forge.descripti: Find a Dwarven Forge, then come back to a Dwarf Elder.
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_forge.story: Our ancestors had a forge deeper than this city. Find it and tell me if the anvils still ring.
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_forge.title: The Lost Forge
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_iron.descriptio: Bring 20 Iron Ingots to a Dwarf Elder.
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_iron.story: The mines run dry and the forges starve. Twenty ingots of iron, surface dweller.
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_iron.title: Iron for the Forges
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_runes.descripti: Bring the Elder's rune tablet to a Scholar.
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_runes.story: These runes are older than my clan. Let one of your surface scholars try to read them.
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_runes.title: Runes for the Scholar
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_skeletons.descr: Defeat 12 Skeletons, then come back to a Dwarf Elder.
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_skeletons.story: The old dead rise in the lower halls and shoot at our miners. Break their bones.
npcquest.wayfarers.elder_skeletons.title: Bones in the Halls
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_bandits.descrip: Defeat 8 Pillagers, then report to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_bandits.story: Bandits camp along the plains and rob our couriers. The Guild pays well for every one of them.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_bandits.title: Bounty: Bandits
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_letter.descript: Carry the Guild's sealed letter to a Druid of the World Tree.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_letter.story: The druids of the Hollow Giant Tree have not answered our letters. Bring this one to them in person.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_letter.title: A Letter for the Druids
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_provisions.desc: Bring 12 Bread to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_provisions.stor: Our scouts leave at dawn with empty bags. Twelve loaves would keep them going for a week.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_roads.descripti: Defeat 10 Zombies, then report to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_roads.story: The dead walk the trade roads at night. Thin them out and the caravans will thank you.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_roads.title: Clear the Roads
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_survey.descript: Find a Ruined Watchtower, then report to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_survey.story: One of our old watchtowers went silent. Find one and tell me what is left of it.
npcquest.wayfarers.guild_survey.title: Survey the Watchtower
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_books.story: I filled my last notebook last night. Six books, and I can write down everything you will find.
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_books.title: Blank Pages
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_library.descr: Find a Forgotten Library, then come back to a Scholar.
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_library.story: Somewhere a whole library sank under moss and ink. Find it, and tell me if the shelves still stand.
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_library.title: The Forgotten Library
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_notes.descrip: Bring the Scholar's notes to a Tinkerer.
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_notes.story: These are drawings of an old clockwork. The tinkerers of the Clockwork Citadel will know what to make of them.
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_notes.title: Notes for the Tinkerer
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_wraiths.descr: Defeat 4 Map Wraiths, then come back to a Scholar.
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_wraiths.story: Map Wraiths shred every chart they touch. Put a few of them to rest and our maps will stay whole.
npcquest.wayfarers.scholar_wraiths.title: Torn Maps
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_copper.descrip: Bring 24 Copper Ingots to a Tinkerer.
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_copper.story: My boilers leak like sieves. Twenty-four copper ingots and they will hold the steam again.
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_copper.title: Copper for the Boilers
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_foundry.descri: Find a Geothermal Foundry, then come back to a Tinkerer.
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_foundry.story: They say a foundry was built on the flank of a volcano. I must know how they tame that heat!
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_foundry.title: Heat of the Earth
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_parts.descript: Bring the Tinkerer's crate of parts to a Dwarf Elder.
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_parts.story: The dwarves of the deep city ordered pistons for their rails. Mind the stairs, it is heavy.
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_parts.title: Spare Parts for the Deep
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_spiders.descri: Defeat 6 Clockwork Spiders, then come back to a Tinkerer.
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_spiders.story: Some of my clockwork spiders ran off and went feral. Bring them down before they bite someone.
npcquest.wayfarers.tinker_spiders.title: Runaway Spiders

tip.wayfarers.sorting_chest: Sorting chest: it sorts itself and pulls in nearby drops.
